Data.String: Four-effect falling-film evaporator, forward feed (D-008, D-039): 97 % of the water off, 81 t/h; effects at about 1.0, 0.6, 0.3 and 0.12 bar(a) (ASSUMED); each effect's vapour heats the next.
FIC-4001 sets the LP steam (13.7 MW, Q4); DIC-4002 draws the concentrate at 71 wt% lactic acid (D-008); LIC-4011A to C hold the sumps on the forward transfers.
Condensates of E-401B to D and E-402 (14.5 MW, Q5) to V-401 under K-401A/B; P-401A/B on LIC-4004 to WWT (S15).
pnb plants & bytes GmbH, Aachen, Germany
